```{r load-data, include=FALSE}

ps <- get(load(Diabetes_path))  # rename directly to ps

ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))
ps_pa  <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))
```

```{r filter-samples}
sd <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")

# Define countries with sufficient sample size
valid_countries <- c("China", "Sweden")

samples_to_keep <- sd %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  filter(if_all(c("Nr..reads.sequenced", "Host.age"), ~!is.na(.))) %>%
  filter(Sex %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%
  #filter(Country %in% valid_countries) %>%
  # filter(Recent.antibiotics.use %in% c("N", "Y")) %>%
  pull(SampleID)



cat("Samples kept:", length(samples_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Samples removed:", nsamples(ps) - length(samples_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Country distribution:\n")
print(table(sd[samples_to_keep, "Country"]))
```


```{r build-phyloseq, include=FALSE}
sample_data(ps)$keep <- sample_names(ps) %in% samples_to_keep
ps_clean <- subset_samples(ps, keep == TRUE)
sample_data(ps_clean)$keep <- NULL
sample_data(ps)$keep <- NULL
ps_clean <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_clean) > 0, ps_clean)

# Add readable disease label to ps after filtering
sample_data(ps_clean)$Disease <- ifelse(
  sample_data(ps_clean)$Disease.MESH.ID == "D003924", "T2D", "Healthy"
)
sample_data(ps_clean)$Continent <- case_when(
  sample_data(ps_clean)$Country == "China" ~ "Asia",
  TRUE ~ "Europe"
)
# Note: data is relative abundance - Observed/Chao1 not valid
ps_rel_cleaned <- transform_sample_counts(ps_clean, function(x) x / sum(x))
ps_pa_cleaned  <- transform_sample_counts(ps_clean, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))

ps_clr <- microbiome::transform(ps_clean, transform = "clr")
```

```{r}
ps_t2d <- subset_samples(ps_clean, Disease == "T2D")
cat("T2D samples:\n")
print(table(sample_data(ps_t2d)$Continent))
```

```{r rda-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
# ── Change dataset here ──────────────────────────────────────────────
rda_data <- ps_t2d   # swap to ps_clean, ps_balanced, etc.
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 1. CLR-transformed OTU matrix from rda_data
rda_clr <- microbiome::transform(rda_data, "clr")
otu_clr <- as.data.frame(otu_table(rda_clr))
if (taxa_are_rows(rda_clr)) otu_clr <- t(otu_clr)
otu_clr <- as.data.frame(otu_clr)

# 2. Metadata from rda_data
meta_rda <- sample_data(rda_data) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  select(Sex, Continent, Host.age, Nr..reads.sequenced, Disease) %>%
  mutate(
    Host.age            = scale(Host.age),
    Nr..reads.sequenced = scale(Nr..reads.sequenced),
    Sex                 = as.factor(Sex),
    Continent           = as.factor(Continent),
    Disease             = as.factor(Disease)
  )

# 3. RDA
rda_result <- rda(otu_clr ~ Sex + Continent + Host.age + Nr..reads.sequenced + Disease,
                  data = meta_rda)

# 4. Variance explained
eig  <- rda_result$CCA$eig
pct1 <- round(eig[1] / rda_result$tot.chi * 100, 1)
pct2 <- round(eig[2] / rda_result$tot.chi * 100, 1)

# 5. Site scores + metadata
site_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  left_join(
    sample_data(rda_data) %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

# 6a. Biplot arrows
biplot_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "bp") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable")

# Calculate site_range here so it's available for both species and biplot scaling
site_range  <- max(abs(c(site_scores$RDA1, site_scores$RDA2)))
arrow_scale <- site_range * 0.8 /
  max(sqrt(biplot_scores$RDA1^2 + biplot_scores$RDA2^2))
biplot_scores <- biplot_scores %>%
  mutate(RDA1 = RDA1 * arrow_scale, RDA2 = RDA2 * arrow_scale)

# 6b. Top species scores with taxonomy labels
tax_df <- tax_table(rda_data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  mutate(across(-taxon, ~str_remove(., "^[a-z]__")))

species_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "species") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "taxon") %>%
  mutate(label = Species)

top_species <- species_scores %>%
  mutate(importance = sqrt(RDA1^2 + RDA2^2)) %>%
  slice_max(importance, n = 10)

species_scale <- site_range * 0.6 /
  max(sqrt(top_species$RDA1^2 + top_species$RDA2^2))
top_species <- top_species %>%
  mutate(RDA1 = RDA1 * species_scale, RDA2 = RDA2 * species_scale)

# 8. Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
             aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, color = Continent, shape = Sex),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = biplot_scores,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
               color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = biplot_scores,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 1.15, y = RDA2 * 1.15, label = variable),
            size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Asia" = "#E74C3C", "Europe" = "#3498DB")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Male" = 16, "Female" = 17)) +
  labs(
    title = "RDA: gut microbiome constrained by Disease, Sex, Continent, Age & Read depth",
    x = paste0("RDA1 (", pct1, "% of total variance)"),
    y = paste0("RDA2 (", pct2, "% of total variance)"),
    color = "Continent", shape = "Sex"
  ) +
  geom_segment(data = top_species,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = top_species,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 1.15, y = RDA2 * 1.15, label = label),
            size = 2.5, color = "grey40") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r continent-differential, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Change rank depth here
rank_depth <- "Species"  # swap to "Genus", "Family", etc.

# 1. Get CLR abundance + taxonomy
clr_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(microbiome::transform(rda_data, "clr")))
if (taxa_are_rows(rda_data)) clr_mat <- t(clr_mat)

tax_df <- tax_table(rda_data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  mutate(across(-taxon, ~str_remove(., "^[a-z]__")))

meta <- sample_data(rda_data) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID")

# 2. Wilcoxon test per taxon
clr_long <- clr_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "clr") %>%
  left_join(meta %>% select(SampleID, Continent), by = "SampleID") %>%
  left_join(tax_df %>% select(taxon, all_of(rank_depth)), by = "taxon")

results <- clr_long %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(rank_depth))) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_Asia   = mean(clr[Continent == "Asia"],   na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Europe = mean(clr[Continent == "Europe"], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value     = wilcox.test(
      clr[Continent == "Asia"],
      clr[Continent == "Europe"]
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj     = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    log2FC    = mean_Asia - mean_Europe,  # CLR difference ~ log2FC
    significant = p_adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

# 3. Volcano plot
ggplot(results, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_adj), color = significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_text(data = results %>% filter(significant) %>% slice_max(abs(log2FC), n = 15),
            aes(label = .data[[rank_depth]]),
            size = 2.5, hjust = -0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "#E74C3C")) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Differential abundance between continents at", rank_depth, "level"),
    x = "CLR difference (Asia - Europe)",
    y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
    color = "Significant\n(BH adj. p < 0.05)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

# 4. Print significant taxa
cat("Significant taxa (adj. p < 0.05):", sum(results$significant), "\n")
print(results %>% filter(significant))
```

```{r significant-species-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Filter significant taxa
sig_results <- results %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(log2FC > 0, "Higher in Asia", "Higher in Europe"))

ggplot(sig_results, aes(x = log2FC, 
                         y = reorder(.data[[rank_depth]], log2FC),
                         fill = direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Higher in Asia"   = "#E74C3C",
                                "Higher in Europe" = "#3498DB")) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Significant taxa between continents at", rank_depth, "level"),
    x = "CLR difference (Asia - Europe)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
```

```{r alpha-diversity}
alpha_div <- estimate_richness(ps_clean, measures = "Shannon") %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  left_join(
    as(sample_data(ps_clean), "data.frame") %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

# Sex - Wilcoxon (2 groups)
wilcox.test(Shannon ~ Sex, data = alpha_div)
kruskal.test(Shannon ~ Country, data = alpha_div)

# Host.age - Spearman correlation
cor.test(alpha_div$Shannon, alpha_div$Host.age, method = "spearman")
```
